segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁאָמְרָה: ״הִתְקַבֵּל לִי גִּיטִּי״, צְרִיכָה שְׁתֵּי כִּיתֵּי עֵדִים – שְׁנַיִם שֶׁאוֹמְרִים: ״בְּפָנֵינוּ אָמְרָה״, וּשְׁנַיִם שֶׁאוֹמְרִים: ״בְּפָנֵינוּ קִבֵּל, וְקָרַע״; אֲפִילּוּ הֵן הָרִאשׁוֹנִים וְהֵן הָאַחֲרוֹנִים,
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A woman who said» to an agent: «Receive my bill of divorce for me, requires two sets of witnesses» to confirm that she was divorced when the agent received the bill of divorce. She requires «two» witnesses «who say: In our presence she said» to the agent: Receive my bill of divorce on my behalf, «and two who say: In our presence» the agent «received» the bill of divorce «and tore» it. This testimony is effective «even» if two people «are the first» pair of witnesses «and» the same two «are the latter» pair of witnesses,

segments.he: אוֹ אֶחָד מִן הָרִאשׁוֹנִים, וְאֶחָד מִן הָאַחֲרוֹנִים, וְאֶחָד מִצְטָרֵף עִמָּהֶן.
segments.en: «or» if there is «one» witness «from the first» pair of witnesses «and one» witness «from the latter» pair, «and one» additional witness «joins with them» as the second witness in both testimonies.

moves.summary: a woman who appointed an agent for receipt needs two sets of witnesses, to her statement and to his receipt
the same witnesses, or one from each set with a third joining, suffice

positions.claim: two sets of witnesses are needed: that she said 'receive', and that he received and tore; the same witnesses may serve for both
